# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands image filter, color filter, and paint bounds APIs. It also restores fast small-sigma raster blurs, reduces repeated SKSurface.Canvas access overhead, and refreshes HarfBuzz shaping.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now produce compile errors** — The legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors with sampleCount, SKRunBuffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality are now error-obsolete. Use the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive integration removed** — The deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension is no longer included in the SkiaSharp package. Applications and notebooks that depend on its renderers must provide their own display integration. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and compatibility across Windows, WebAssembly, and Direct3D builds. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))

## API Surface

- **Paint bounds support quick-reject culling** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to compute conservative paint bounds for safe use with SKCanvas.QuickReject(). ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes** — Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() with tile-mode and input-filter overloads, plus SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for explicitly transparent filter output. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Overdraw visualization is complete** — Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() to map SKOverdrawCanvas counts through a six-color heat-map palette. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blur performance restored** — Routes small CPU image blurs back through the faster box-approximation path used by Chromium. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream access synchronized** — Updates the bundled m150 engine with an upstream fix for concurrent stream access in the macOS CoreText typeface implementation. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface reuses its canvas wrapper** — Caches SKSurface.Canvas across repeated accesses and recreates the managed wrapper if a caller explicitly disposes it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with fixes for AAT and Arabic shaping, COLR v1 rendering, glyph extents, and subsetting.
